title: spec(data-engine): engine-side `searchFields` declarations refuse an empty list, as the engine now does (spec half of #27732)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk

Carries the spec half of #27732 item 1; #27732 keeps the engine half (the in-process engine refuses an empty `searchFields` / `search.fields` override, 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, built in its card thread).

## What is left

After PR #27725 the shared `FullTextSearchSchema.fields` refuses `[]`, and #27732 makes the in-process engine refuse an empty override too. The engine-side option declarations still admit `[]`:

- `EngineQueryOptionsSchema.searchFields` (`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`, ~line 190)
- `EngineAggregateOptionsSchema.searchFields` (~line 514)
- `EngineCountOptionsSchema.searchFields` (~line 559)

So the engine-side declarations say two things about one value: `search.fields: []` is refused (it reuses `FullTextSearchSchema`), while `searchFields: []` is admitted, and the engine refuses both. Flip the three `searchFields` declarations to refuse an empty list, so the declaration never admits what the engine refuses (the #27008 shape on the projection axis).

Re-check: `grep -n "searchFields" packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`

This narrows a published declaration: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, a contract review, the ADR-0087 disposition. It is `packages/spec`, so `domain:spec` (triage decides). Item 2 of #27732 (the comma-string transport encoding) is by design (triage `6519918549`) and is not part of this card.

Filed by `domain:server` seat 1 from the #27732 card thread's report.
